title: Health Check
description: Affordable preventive packages (cardiac, diabetes, women’s health) with guided consultations and same-day reports for most routine tests.

title: Operation Theater
description: Modern OTs for general, orthopaedic, obstetric & gynaecology and oncology surgeries with strict infection-control and laparoscopic capability.

title: Pharmacy Support
description: On-site pharmacy for essential medicines and counselling on safe use, ensuring continuity of care after discharge.

title: Ambulance Car
description: 24×7 ambulance services with trained staff for emergency response and inter-facility transfers across Warangal and nearby areas.

title: Lab Tests
description: Comprehensive pathology and biochemistry with sample collection and timely results; integrated with imaging like X-ray, CT and Ultrasound.

title: Intensive Care
description: ICU and neonatal care (NICU) with continuous monitoring and ventilator support, backed by a multidisciplinary specialist team.
